description: List bounded release history for an app, optionally filtered to a channel, while preserving runtime-lane identity and all release options.

appId.description: OtaKit app ID. Optional on a local connection whose project configures one; required otherwise.

channel.description: Named channel, or null for the base channel

cursor.description: The previous page's nextCursor; omit for the first page

title: List OtaKit release history
